name: Rivastigmine
metabolism: Cholinesterase-mediated hydrolysis produces a decarbamylated metabolite. CYP enzymes contribute minimally; metabolites are subsequently eliminated mainly in urine.
summary: Rivastigmine is an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor used for dementia associated with Alzheimer's or Parkinson's disease. It is given orally or as a transdermal patch.
